description: MBIE energy statistics and modelling is a data repository run by Ministry of Business, Innovation and Employment, New Zealand. The page gives the national energy balance, electricity, gas, oil and coal statistics, generation and price data, and the energy scenario models of the ministry as downloadable spreadsheets. Coverage: New Zealand. It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as xlsx, csv; access is free of charge and open to view; downloads may need a free account. The licence is: terms set by the site, not read in this search. Caveats: the home page was opened on 2026-09-30 and only its title ("no page title") was read, so the holdings, the current terms and the availability of downloads were not browsed, and this description rests on the agency's publicly documented role and may lag the site. It can support energy system and scenario studies of New Zealand. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet.
